settings.emailFileUploadHint: File attachments require a paid plan. If billing isn't set up, enabling this may cause form submissions to fail.
settings.commentEmailNotifyDesc: Get notified via email when new comments are posted. Requires RESEND_API_KEY environment variable.
settings.emailConfirmationSent: Confirmation emails have been sent to both your current and new email addresses. You must confirm from both to complete the change.
settings.secureEmailChangeHint1: To change your email, confirmation links must be clicked from both the current and new email addresses. (Secure email change is enabled by default and can be disabled in the Supabase dashboard.)
settings.secureEmailChangeHint2: Confirmation links are valid for 1 hour after sending.
settings.securePasswordChangeHint: When Secure password change is enabled, users must re-login to change their password if their last login was more than 24 hours ago. (Can be disabled in the Supabase dashboard.)
settings.passwordRuleSecure: Password must be at least 8 characters and include an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, number, and special character.
settings.passwordRuleDefault: Password must be at least 6 characters. (Supabase default)
settings.signOutAllHint: Immediately invalidate every browser and device currently signed in to this admin account. Use when you suspect a leak or want to clear sessions on shared machines.
settings.signOutAllConfirmDesc: You will be signed out from every device including this one. You'll need to log in again with your password. Continue?
settings.devicesEmpty: No trusted devices yet. The first sign-in adds one via email approval.
settings.revokeDeviceDesc: Remove this device from the trusted list? It will require email approval again on next sign-in.
settings.revokeCurrentDeviceDesc: Remove your current device from the trusted list? You'll need email approval again next time you sign in. (Your active session stays — use 'Sign out everywhere' to fully sign out.)
settings.authSettingsDesc: The following settings can be changed in the Supabase dashboard.
settings.authSettingsPath1: Authentication > [Configuration] Sign In / Providers > [Auth Providers] Email
settings.conflictDesc: Code defaults have changed but differ from saved DB values. Select items to apply the latest defaults.
settings.profileConflictDesc: Profile defaults have changed in code. You can apply the latest values per section.
settings.confirmPasswordDesc: Enter your current password to confirm changes.
settings.mediaUploadHint: Set the maximum size allowed for each media type on upload.
settings.mediaUploadDesc: Formats within the same group share the same size limit. Use the + button in each group to enable additional formats.
settings.mediaUploadDescDnD: Drag format chips into a size bucket to set its limit. Drag into the inactive pool to disable (built-in formats can't be disabled).
settings.customMimeBlocked: This type is blocked by security policy
settings.envVarPrefixMismatch: Doesn't start with expected prefix "{prefix}" — verify key format
settings.envPasteHint: Paste text in KEY=VALUE format. Only keys matching this page's variables will be filled into the edit area. Press the save button to actually persist.
settings.fontHint: Choose from presets or type a Google Fonts name in the input field. (e.g., Roboto, Nanum Gothic)
settings.aboutInfiniteScrollLabel: Loop from the last panel straight back to the first instead of stopping at the end
settings.aboutArchitectureHint: Project directory structure shown in Architecture panel. Indent 0=root, 1=group, 2=child.
settings.aboutHeroStyleHint: Leave empty for default. Accepts any CSS value.
settings.aboutPanelVisibilityHint: Unchecked panels are hidden in both desktop horizontal scroll and mobile tabs.
settings.aboutStudioHint: Edit directly on the live About page. Click any text to change it, and hover an item to add or remove it. Each panel saves on its own, and Revert or Defaults restores it anytime.
settings.aboutTechStackHint: Click a chip to edit its name, category, and icon. Use + Add to quickly pick from presets (with icons) or enter your own.
settings.aboutOverviewHint: Edit the project intro paragraph, highlight chips, and stat cards.
settings.aboutFeaturesHint: Edit each card's fields directly, remove, or add new entries.
settings.aboutProcessHint: Edit title and description for each step in both Korean and English.
settings.aboutSecurityHint: Edit layer, icon, title, description, and scope for each security entry.
settings.giscusHint: giscus embeds GitHub Discussions as comments. On a public repo: enable Discussions, install the giscus GitHub app, then get the repo/category IDs from giscus.app and paste them below.
settings.giscusNeedsToken: GITHUB_TOKEN is required — go set it
settings.giscusNoDiscussions: Discussions is not enabled on this repository.
settings.giscusThemeHint: giscus preset name (light, dark, noborder_dark…) or a custom CSS URL. Empty = default.
